## Table

| Kind | Extensions | Renders as |
|---|---|---|
| Markdown | `.md` `.markdown` | GitHub-style HTML |
| PDF | `.pdf` | Pages |
| Spreadsheet | `.xlsx` `.csv` | A grid |
